top_signals.title: Tokenization and TradFi-DeFi Convergence Reshape Capital Markets
top_signals.summary: Tokenization accelerates into 2026's defining force. BlackRock's Larry Fink calls it a gateway to vast new investable assets beyond stocks and bonds[4]. Entire classes go on-chain, enhancing liquidity and access. Stablecoins bridge this, evolving from trading tools to fiat-decentralized conduits[4]. Meanwhile, M&A surges as projects consolidate for dominance, per Tiger—winners scale fast in a maturing Web3[2]. Analysis reveals a convergence tipping point.
